margin_of_error_definition: |computed - measured| / |measured| * 100 — same grading-style % accuracy used in high-school/college; how far off the observable we are.
alphafold_analog_note: AlphaFold reports structural metrics (lDDT, GDT, TM-score, RMSD in Å), not % off a tabulated answer. Our % margin is the direct 'how wrong am I' readout.

precision_gates_pct.description: Beat AlphaFold credibility in genetics: all mechanistic margins under 0.5%; 0.02% is world-class scalar precision.
